mapper.select: SELECT e.*, sl.layer_name AS layer_name, sl.shelf_code AS shelf_code FROM layer_capacity_expand_record e LEFT JOIN shelf_layer sl ON e.layer_code = sl.layer_code WHERE e.status IN ('PENDING', 'ACTIVE') AND e.start_time <= #{now} AND e.end_time >= #{now} ORDER BY e.start_time DESC, e.id DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE layer_capacity_expand_record SET status = 'EXPIRED', finish_time = end_time, finish_conclusion = '到期自动结束，恢复原配额', finish_operator = '系统', update_time = #{now} WHERE status IN ('PENDING', 'ACTIVE') AND end_time < #{now}
